admin_panel:
🔧 Admin panel

Products:
/addproduct — Add product
/editproduct <id> — Edit product
/deleteproduct <id> — Delete product

Categories:
/addcategory <emoji> <name> — Create category
/editcategory <id> name|emoji <value> — Change field
/deletecategory <id> — Delete category
/listcategories — Category list with IDs

Orders:
/orders_all [status] — All orders
/setdelivered <id> — Mark order as delivered
/reviews — Latest reviews (moderation)
/export_orders — Export orders to CSV

Promo codes:
/addpromo <code> <discount%> [max_uses] [days] [category_id] — Create promo code
/listpromos — Active promo codes
/deletepromo <id> — Deactivate promo code

Design:
/btnstyle — Configure button colors

Analytics:
/analytics — Sales statistics
